claims.text: Applying spark plasma sintering to HfMoTaTiZr will reduce its density.
Applying spark plasma sintering will preserve the alloy's room-temperature mechanical performance.
Applying spark plasma sintering will preserve the alloy's high-temperature mechanical performance.
Spark plasma sintering will produce finer grains in HfMoTaTiZr.
Spark plasma sintering will improve or optimize phase formation in HfMoTaTiZr.
Spark plasma sintering will enhance densification of HfMoTaTiZr.
SPS-induced microstructural refinement is the mechanism responsible for the predicted property changes.
SPS-induced optimization of phase formation is responsible for the predicted property changes.
The SPS-processed alloy will maintain or improve yield strength at room temperature.
The SPS-processed alloy will maintain or improve yield strength at 1000 °C.
As-cast HfMoTaTiZr has a density of 10.21 g cm−3.
As-cast HfMoTaTiZr has a room-temperature yield strength of 1600 MPa.
As-cast HfMoTaTiZr has an elevated-temperature yield strength of 855 MPa.

contradictions.description: The hypothesis predicts lower density while also proposing enhanced densification as a mediator. No distinction between theoretical/compositional density and porosity-dependent bulk density is supplied, so the stated mediator points against the density outcome.
